newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Mubarak leaves for Davos economic forum.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak leaves for Davos economic forum.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak left Cairo on Friday on his way to Switzerland to attend the Davos World Economic Forum, airport sources said.
The Egyptian television said Mubarak was accompanied by a high-ranking delegation, including the foreign and information ministers.
Egypt's official press has trumpeted Mubarak's visit as the perfect opportunity to showcase the recent success of the country's economy.

Egypt, which in November hosted a regional economic conference sponsored by the World Economic Forum, has piqued the interest of foreign investors who have poured millions of pounds in the stock market.
It also proudly bears investment ratings and foreign and local currency credit ratings from the international agency Standard & Poors.

During Sunday's conference, Mubarak is expected to hold his first meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu since the Palestinians and Israelis signed a deal to implement a long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment from the West Bank town of Hebron.
Media reports said Mubarak would fly to Paris on Monday to meet French President Jacques Chirac.
